data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Per-leaf test matrix must assert FULL mutation-list equality (including ordering), not just guard non-raise. (a) Authorized cells (outbound_create+create, inbound_clean_label+delete) assert returned mutation list equals exactly [expected_mutation] with no piggybacked dso-id-* writes. (b) non-dso-id-payload test asserts guard does NOT raise when leaves write non-dso-id-* labels (e.g., sprint-id-*) — proves payload-prefix check is correctly scoped, not overbroad. Without this, authorized leaf could silently emit extra dso-id-* writes and test passes (implicit_assumption).
